title: Why Linux is making a desktop comeback

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Linux is making a desktop comeback because open source innovation outpaces closed ecosystems. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Windows and macOS dominate with polished UIs, enterprise support, and hardware integration Linux can't match. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Linux offers unmatched customization, with tools like Wayland and KDE Plasma leading in performance and flexibility. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But Linux lacks universal driver support and app compatibility—critical for mainstream adoption. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Without broad app support, Linux can't replace Windows on the desktop. (4 sec)
